    if isinstance(node,ast.keyword) and node.arg=='availability_pairs' and isinstance(node.value,ast.Constant) and node.value.value==147:node.value=ast.Constant(49)

def helper_case(fault=None,changed_name=None):
    local=MemoryFS();remote=MemoryFS();copies=[];launches=[];calls=[];queries=[]
    gpu={0:18,1:24000,2:18,3:18};disk=2_000_000_000
    for name in source_names|set(files):local.path(str(project/name)).write_bytes((project/name).read_bytes())
    for name in source_names:remote.path(root+'/'+name).write_bytes((project/name).read_bytes())
    local.path(str(helper)).write_bytes(helper.read_bytes())
    dump(remote.path(run+'/result.json'),dict(status='COMPLETE',epochs=50,arguments=dict(dataset='RGBNT100',variant='demo',seed=42)))
    dump(remote.path(run+'/exit.json'),dict(exit_code=0))
    remote.path(run+'/best.pth').write_bytes(b'synthetic fixed frozen checkpoint')
    remote.path(run+'/best_dev_arrays.npz').write_bytes(b'synthetic fixed saved arrays')
    if fault in ('exit_nonzero','terminal_not_complete','terminal_epoch49','terminal_wrong_variant'):
        if fault=='exit_nonzero':dump(remote.path(run+'/exit.json'),dict(exit_code=1))
        else:
            value=json.loads(remote.path(run+'/result.json').read_text())
            if fault=='terminal_not_complete':value['status']='RUNNING'
            if fault=='terminal_epoch49':value['epochs']=49
            if fault=='terminal_wrong_variant':value['arguments']['variant']='axis_mass_fullref'
            dump(remote.path(run+'/result.json'),value)
    proof={name:dict(bytes=remote.path(run+'/'+name).stat().st_size,sha256=hashlib.sha256(remote.path(run+'/'+name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for name in ('best.pth','best_dev_arrays.npz','result.json','exit.json')}
    review=dict(status='PASS',blockers=[],helper_sha256=helper_hash,checked_source_sha256=dict(source_hashes))
    if fault=='review_blocked':review['status']='BLOCKED'
    if fault=='review_has_blockers':review['blockers']=['synthetic blocker']
    if fault=='review_wrong_helper':review['helper_sha256']='wrong'
    if fault=='review_wrong_source':review['checked_source_sha256'][changed_name]='wrong'
    if fault=='review_extra_source':review['checked_source_sha256']['unexpected.py']='wrong'
    if fault=='review_missing_source':review['checked_source_sha256'].pop(files[0])
    dump(local.path(str(project/review_rel)),review)
    dump(local.path(str(project/'results/preflight/axis_collaboration_v4_missing_development27_launch.json')),dict(input_files={'RGBNT100_demo_s42':dict(files=proof)}))
    dump(local.path(str(project/'results/preflight/anytoany49_2026_launch.json')),base)
    if fault=='local_source_drift':local.path(str(project/changed_name)).write_bytes(b'changed source')
    if fault=='remote_source_drift':remote.path(root+'/'+changed_name).write_bytes(b'changed source')
    if fault=='input_same_size_hash_drift':
        path=remote.path(run+'/'+changed_name);b=path.read_bytes();path.write_bytes(bytes([b[0]^1])+b[1:])
    if fault=='input_size_drift':
        path=remote.path(run+'/'+changed_name);path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes()+b'x')
    if fault=='gpu0_busy':gpu[0]=500
    if fault=='disk_at_1GB':disk=1_000_000_000
    if fault=='output_exists':remote.path(output).mkdir()
    if fault=='launcher_exists':remote.path(root+'/'+files[1]).write_bytes((project/files[1]).read_bytes())
    if fault=='log_exists':remote.path(output+'.log').write_bytes(b'existing log')
    original_inputs={name:remote.path(run+'/'+name).read_bytes() for name in proof}
    sentinel=root+'/runs/existing_B_controller_3308524.read_only_sentinel'
    remote.path(sentinel).write_bytes(b'B process on GPU1 must remain untouched')
    def command(argv):
        assert argv==['scp',*options,(project/files[1]).as_posix(),'2026:'+root+'/'+files[1]]
        remote.path(root+'/'+files[1]).write_bytes(local.path(str(project/files[1])).read_bytes());copies.append(files[1])
        if fault=='copied_launcher_drift':remote.path(root+'/'+files[1]).write_bytes(b'changed after copy')
        if fault=='source_drift_before_start':remote.path(root+'/'+files[0]).write_bytes(b'changed after copy')
        if fault=='gpu0_busy_before_start':gpu[0]=500
        if fault=='output_exists_before_start':remote.path(output).mkdir()
        return ''
    def remote_python(host,source):
        assert host=='2026';phase='start' if 'start_new_session' in source else 'guard';calls.append(phase)
        if fault is None:generated_scripts.append(dict(host=host,phase=phase,source=source))
        nodes=[n for n in ast.parse(source).body if not isinstance(n,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom))]
        def check_output(argv,text):
            assert argv==['nvidia-smi','-i','0','--query-gpu=memory.used','--format=csv,noheader,nounits'] and text is True
            queries.append(0);return str(gpu[0])+'\n'
        def spawn(argv,cwd,start_new_session,stdout,stderr,env):
            expected=[python,'-u',files[1],'--training-root',training,'--variant','demo','--output',output,'--data-root','/data/gaob/Re-ID/dataset','--pretrained','/data/gaob/Re-ID/Trifusion/pertrained-model/ViT-B-16.pt']
            assert argv==expected and str(cwd)==root and start_new_session is True and stderr==-2
            assert env['OMP_NUM_THREADS']==env['MKL_NUM_THREADS']==env['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']=='4'
            assert str(stdout)==output+'.log'
            remote.path(output).mkdir();launches.append(dict(argv=argv,gpu0_only_in_child=True));return NS(pid=12345)
        env=dict(hashlib=hashlib,json=json,Path=remote.path,shutil=NS(disk_usage=lambda p:NS(free=disk)),subprocess=NS(check_output=check_output,Popen=spawn,STDOUT=-2),os=NS(environ={}),time=NS(time=lambda:1234))
        stream=io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stream):exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),'<actual-generated-'+phase+'-AST>','exec'),env)
        return stream.getvalue()
    env=dict(__file__=str(helper),Path=local.path,PROJECT=local.path(str(project)),HOSTS=hosts,OPTIONS=options,command=command,remote_python=remote_python,json=json,hashlib=hashlib,datetime=datetime)
    error=None
    try:
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):exec(helper_code,env)
    except (AssertionError,FileExistsError) as exc:error=type(exc).__name__
    receipt=local.path(str(project/receipt_rel))
    if fault is None:
        assert error is None and copies==[files[1]] and len(launches)==1 and calls==['guard','start']
        value=json.loads(receipt.read_text());assert value['host']=='2026' and value['variant']=='demo' and value['availability']['original_input_files']==proof
        assert set(value['source_sha256'])==source_names|set(files)
        receipt_bytes=receipt.read_bytes()
        try:
            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):exec(helper_code,env)
        except AssertionError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('helper rerun started duplicate')
        assert len(launches)==1 and copies==[files[1]] and receipt.read_bytes()==receipt_bytes
    else:
        assert error is not None,(fault,changed_name)
        assert launches==[] and not receipt.exists(),(fault,changed_name)
        if fault not in ('copied_launcher_drift','source_drift_before_start','gpu0_busy_before_start','output_exists_before_start','log_exists'):assert copies==[],(fault,changed_name)
    assert all(remote.path(run+'/'+name).read_bytes()==value for name,value in original_inputs.items())
    assert remote.path(sentinel).read_bytes()==b'B process on GPU1 must remain untouched'
    assert all(g==0 for g in queries)
    return dict(fault=fault,changed_name=changed_name,result='PASS',rejection=error,remote_AST_phases=calls,source_copies=copies,controller_launch_count=len(launches),input_files_preserved=True,gpu1_sentinel_preserved=True,real_remote_calls=0)

helper_cases=[helper_case()]
for fault in ('review_blocked','review_has_blockers','review_wrong_helper','review_extra_source','review_missing_source','exit_nonzero','terminal_not_complete','terminal_epoch49','terminal_wrong_variant','gpu0_busy','disk_at_1GB','output_exists','launcher_exists','log_exists','copied_launcher_drift','source_drift_before_start','gpu0_busy_before_start','output_exists_before_start'):helper_cases.append(helper_case(fault))
for name in files:helper_cases.append(helper_case('review_wrong_source',name))
for name in sorted(source_names):
    for fault in ('local_source_drift','remote_source_drift'):helper_cases.append(helper_case(fault,name))
for name in original_manifest['files']:
    for fault in ('input_same_size_hash_drift','input_size_drift'):helper_cases.append(helper_case(fault,name))
write('003-deployment-mock-checks.json',dict(status='PASS',scope='Actual helper AST and generated remote AST; synthetic in-memory checkpoint bytes and proofs; no SSH, SCP, GPU or neural execution',cases=helper_cases,cases_count=len(helper_cases),exact_single_launcher_copy=True,existing_leaf_not_copied=True,original_inputs_never_written=True,rerun_rejects_duplicate=True))
write('004-generated-remote-AST.json',dict(status='PASS',scripts=generated_scripts[:2],note='Source captured from clean mock with synthetic frozen-file proofs; fixed host, source digests, paths and commands are actual helper output.'))

main=next(n for n in controller_tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='main')
main_code=compile(ast.Module(body=[main],type_ignores=[]),str(project/files[1]),'exec')
def controller_case(fault=None,changed_name=None):
    fs=MemoryFS();jobs=[];workers=[];idle_gpus=[];spawns=[]
    args=['review','--training-root',training,'--variant','demo','--output',output,'--data-root','/data/gaob/Re-ID/dataset','--pretrained','/data/gaob/Re-ID/Trifusion/pertrained-model/ViT-B-16.pt']
    term=dict(status='COMPLETE',epochs=50,arguments=dict(dataset='RGBNT100',variant='demo',seed=42))
    if fault=='terminal_not_complete':term['status']='RUNNING'
    if fault=='terminal_epoch49':term['epochs']=49
    if fault=='terminal_dataset_mismatch':term['arguments']['dataset']='MSVR310'
    if fault=='terminal_variant_mismatch':term['arguments']['variant']='axis_mass_fullref'
    dump(fs.path(run+'/result.json'),term);dump(fs.path(run+'/exit.json'),dict(exit_code=1 if fault=='training_exit_nonzero' else 0))
    fs.path(run+'/best.pth').write_bytes(b'synthetic checkpoint');fs.path(run+'/best_dev_arrays.npz').write_bytes(b'synthetic arrays')
    class Pool:
        def __init__(self,max_workers):workers.append(max_workers)
        def __enter__(self):return self
        def __exit__(self,*a):return False
        def map(self,fn,values):jobs.extend(values);return [fn(job) for job in values]
    def spawn(argv,stdout,stderr,env):
        smoke='--smoke' in argv;stage='smoke' if smoke else 'full'
        assert argv[:3]==[python,'-u','missing_anytoany_development.py']
        assert argv[argv.index('--run-dir')+1]==run
        assert env['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES']=='0' and env['OMP_NUM_THREADS']==env['MKL_NUM_THREADS']==env['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']=='4'
        expected_out=output+'/RGBNT100_demo_s42/'+stage
        assert argv[argv.index('--output')+1]==expected_out
        spawns.append(stage)
        def wait():
            result=dict(status='PASS' if smoke else 'COMPLETE',optimizer_updates=0,state_tensor_versions_unchanged=True,normal_feature_max_error=0)
            if not smoke:result['measurements']={str(i):{} for i in range(49)}
            if fault==stage+'_status':result['status']='FAILED'
            if fault==stage+'_optimizer':result['optimizer_updates']=1
            if fault==stage+'_state':result['state_tensor_versions_unchanged']=False
            if fault==stage+'_parity':result['normal_feature_max_error']=1e-12
            if not smoke and fault=='full_count48':result['measurements'].pop('0')
            if fault==stage+'_input_hash':
                path=fs.path(run+'/'+changed_name);b=path.read_bytes();path.write_bytes(bytes([b[0]^1])+b[1:])
            dump(fs.path(expected_out+('/smoke.json' if smoke else '/result.json')),result)
            return 1 if fault==stage+'_exit' else 0
        return NS(pid=100+len(spawns),wait=wait)
    env=dict(argparse=argparse,Path=fs.path,json=json,hashlib=hashlib,idle=lambda gpu:idle_gpus.append(gpu),subprocess=NS(Popen=spawn,STDOUT=-2),os=NS(environ={'CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':'1'}),sys=NS(executable=python),time=NS(time=lambda:1234),write_json=dump,ThreadPoolExecutor=Pool)
    previous_argv=sys.argv;error=None;sys.argv=args
    try:
        exec(main_code,env);env['main']()
    except AssertionError:error='AssertionError'
    finally:sys.argv=previous_argv
    done=fs.path(output+'/controller_result.json')
    assert workers==[1] and jobs==[('RGBNT100',0)] and all(g==0 for g in idle_gpus)
    if fault is None:
        assert error is None and spawns==['smoke','full'] and idle_gpus==[0,0]
        result=json.loads(done.read_text());assert result['status']=='COMPLETE' and result['availability_pairs']==49 and len(result['runs'])==1
        assert result['optimizer_updates']==0 and result['official_test_uses']==0
    else:
        assert error and not done.exists(),fault
        if fault.startswith('smoke_'):assert spawns==['smoke'],fault
        if fault.startswith('terminal_') or fault=='training_exit_nonzero':assert spawns==[],fault
    return dict(fault=fault,changed_name=changed_name,result='PASS',rejection=error,stages_started=spawns,idle_gpus=idle_gpus,jobs=jobs,max_workers=workers)

controller_cases=[controller_case()]
